intro:
Welcome to Alpha City, a neon-lit dystopia where the only thing more valuable than your credits is your sanity. The once-promising promise of blockchain has turned sour, as the coin oligarchs have twisted it into a tool of surveillance and control. But fear not, for in the shadows of the towering skyscrapers, a rebellion stirs.

You find yourselves as unlikely heroes, drawn together by fate and a shared disdain for being merely cogs in the machine. As you navigate the crowded streets and towering megacorps, you are approached by a glitchborn who promises you a chance to strike back against the oppressive regime. Will you join the fight as data-mystics, financiers, stealth saboteurs, or augmented warriors?
